editorial.blurb: A hidden gem serving inventive Vietnamese street food and tapas with impeccable execution and genuine warmth from the owner.
editorial.insiderTip: Come early—this place fills up fast, and you'll want to arrive when dishes like the bone marrow and escargots are fresh off the kitchen.

topDishes.note: A superb, thoughtfully prepared standout that justifies the trip alone
